// diagnostic

E0134

A numeric literal's unit suffix isn't an `#UnitFamily` member in scope (D-UNITLIT1)

What

A numeric literal's unit suffix isn't an `#UnitFamily` member in scope (D-UNITLIT1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0134

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0134: tests/ui/unit_literal_unknown_suffix.stderr.

Error [E0134]: `month` isn't a unit in scope
  --> tests/ui/unit_literal_unknown_suffix.jet:4:11
    |
  4 |     a :: 1month
    |           ^^^^^
 Why: a unit suffix names a member of a `#UnitFamily` you've imported; this suffix isn't one here
 Fix: import the family that defines `month`, or write the number without a suffix
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0134

Error [E0134]: `year` isn't a unit in scope
